quarterly_data.signal: Six months ended September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report, IFRS): revenue JPY 454,899 million (+6.2%; JPY 428,430 million a year earlier), profit before tax JPY 139,294 million (+9.7%), profit JPY 106,363 million (+6.4%), pre-tax margin 30.6% (29.7%); both Life Care and Information & Telecommunication performed well. Segments: Information & Telecommunication revenue JPY 168,793 million (+8.7%), segment profit JPY 90,519 million (+5.3%); Life Care revenue JPY 284,137 million (+4.8%), segment profit JPY 48,655 million (+13.9%). R&D for the half was JPY 17,694 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue JPY 454,899 million (+6.2%); Information & Telecommunication JPY 168,793 million (+8.7%)

quarterly_data.signal: Information & Telecommunication, first half to September 2025 (semi-annual report): semiconductor mask blanks rose sharply on high, stable demand from development activity for advanced EUV products and continued DUV demand growth; FPD photomasks rose as development-use demand recovered at customers; hard-disk glass substrates were flat year on year - 2.5-inch products fell sharply while 3.5-inch products were strong on firm data-center nearline storage demand; imaging products rose sharply as lenses for smart glasses and near-infrared polarizing glass used in optical communications grew. In Life Care, cataract intraocular lenses fell slightly on China's volume-based procurement and chromatography media fell slightly on customer inventory adjustment.
